items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dave and I were working together with Mulligan’s group

ctx.x: I guess we’ll return again to Modern Art because that was recorded in 1958?

Yeah, I was still with Mulligan at that time when we did the recording, and that’s why Dave was there because Dave and I were working together with Mulligan’s group. Like I said, it was Monty Kay’s idea to do it. Benny wrote the arrangements other than “Mox Nix,” which I put on the paper. It turned out good, it turned out satisfactory, but it was like cutting teeth when you were doing it, or pulling teeth. It seems like in my whole career almost everything I did felt like giving birth. It was painful. But then, I…
The recording received critical acclaim. It was well received.
